summary: Issue #2 requests editing an existing Daymark task. The React application currently supports adding, completing, deleting, filtering, searching, and local-storage persistence, but has no edit state or edit controls.
requirements: A user can open an existing task for editing and update its title, notes, category, priority, and due date.
Saving updates the existing task without duplicating it or changing its completion state.
Canceling leaves the task unchanged, and a blank title cannot be saved.
Saved edits participate in current search and filtering behavior and persist across reloads.
Editing controls are keyboard operable and have task-specific accessible names.
constraints: Stay within the harness allowed paths and 12-file change budget.
Preserve existing add, complete, delete, search, filter, summary, and local-storage behavior.
Run configured lint, test, build, and required browser scenarios.
assumptions: All existing editable task fields except completion state should be exposed because the issue asks to correct or update a task.
Editing uses explicit Save and Cancel actions rather than autosave.
Only one task can be edited at a time.

sources.summary: Open issue titled “Add a feature to edit existing tasks” requesting correction or updates to an existing task.
